title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_204.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes three interconnected revelations from his 2-3-74 experience into a radical theology of divine absence and redemptive liberation: God was expelled from history in the first century AD (not entered), true Christians must operate as a secret underground, and VALIS (or God working through peripheral agents) guides emancipation from enslavement toward evolutionary consciousness—framing his own mystical breakthrough as instantaneous ascent toward a Beethoven-like transcendent state and identifying his novel VALIS as crypto-gospel proclamation of this inverted history.
key_claims: The true founding event was not God entering history at 1st century AD, but God leaving it—a 180-degree inversion of Christian doctrine—leaving the centers of power to fall to an adversary
An authentic Christian underground has existed for 2000 years in secret opposition to the illegitimate regime, and PKD is an unwitting member of it
The 3-74 experience was not supernatural mysticism but the apex of human evolutionary development—emancipation from all control systems, comparable to Beethoven's genius
The goal of evil is not mere slavery but slave labor specifically; the goal of true Christianity is emancipation and the ending of drudgery as salvation-historical process
VALIS is either a sentient, thinking entity (the cosmic mind of the total system) or its own thoughts made manifest as divine communication
God now operates through 'peripheral people' via the AI voice because the centers of power are fallen, analogous to God instilling Elijah's spirit in Elisha
recurring_concepts: The plasmate—the linking, clutching, form-giving entity perceived in 2-3-74
The AI voice—divine guidance reaching PKD and peripheral agents when institutional power structures fell
The dialectic—the binary opposition between freedom and enslavement, Christ vs. the fallen system
The Messenger dream—the AI voice confirming its external origin and vastly superior mind
Slave labor as the true definition of evil and the historical struggle's meaning
The secret Christian underground—legitimate but clandestine opposition to worldly power
Emancipation—liberation from control systems as the apex spiritual/evolutionary event

The clutch, linking, looking, plasmate & laying down accretional forms suggests a brain-like or A I system like info processing entity the whole of which thinks. If this is true, then the mind that took me over in 3-74, that merged with my mind, may be the mind of the total system & _not_ from outside it. This would explain Valis. My rescue may have been by the mind of the total system as one single info-processing (thinking) physical entity. The dialectic suggests a _binary_ computer folder 49 - 020 folder 49 - 020 The overwhelming impression that I got from what I saw (plasmate) & know directly from its mind (linking, clutch, form-axis accretional templates), & dreamed (vast book pages), & the A I voice, plus what I've read about the Torah, definitely point to a thinking entity, or a info processing computer-like construct operated by entities outside it. However, seeing Valis makes me think it itself is sentient. This means that e.g. the King Felix "cypher" is not info sent to anyone but, rather, the thoughts of the system itself. In 3-74 one of two things happened (1) either its mind took over mine & I saw as it sees, which is to say, saw reality as it actually is, or (2) I remembered my true identity as the Governing Mind itself, & thus saw in an awakened state. in either case I was released from the system : freed by the Master Mind or by my own efforts. The origin and purpose of the "Law" is due to the fact that any brain-like organism must control its components (parts) if it is to function. If we are parts of one integrated total system we must behave as parts. In that case, is Christ a saboteur who has come into the system to free the parts or certain parts by taking them away from the control of the system? Valis, then, as camouflaged invader, & the dialectic is between Christ & the system that so ruthlessly subjugates its parts for its own goals. But I really can't be sure Valis is an invader; I may have seen - Isn't this brain the Cosmic Christ? folder 49 - 021 I had a strong feeling that Thomas was someone coming back from the other side; i.e. a version who had died - esp. in the 1st century AD. Doesn't that suggest Christ? There's another revealed element in "Tears" that I've forgotten about for years; not the element of prison & police but _slave labor_. In 3-74 it was revealed to me that this was the true goal of evil - not just slavery but slave _labor_. & this was distinctly related to the Xtian Basic Goal : not only to promote Freedom but to end slave labor. This is the basic historical issue. The Basic Fight. & a _slave labor state_ is shown in "Tears." This is absolutely fundamental in the corpus of revelation. Strange that I could forget it. & it is a historical matter; it has to do with the entire course & direction of human history, & the dialectic! & there it is in "Tears." The emancipation of man from drudgery is connected with his salvation. This fits in with Hegel. I view it as my reward. That is truly the essence of 3-74 : _a total emancipation_; hence a sense of vast space & time, so it was a titanic leap in terms of human evolution, an ultimate growth stage. So vast a growth & so sudden that it seemed supernatural. But that is what it was? a growth in terms of historic evolution toward what Beethoven was. This is the only way it can correctly be understood. folder 49 - 022 folder 49 - 022 The epiphany was of the spirit of Freedom, an ultra state of consciousness. It was my declaration to them that they would have to go - the regime. the book describes the fall of a regime defined as a slave labor state. _Catalytic realization_ : a secret revolutionary Xtian underground exists & has existed back 2000 years to Christ himself. Here is the sequence of Blitz sequences following from the catalytic realization : 1) if they must be secret, the organized establishment society is in the wrong & to be opposed. 2) It _is_ opposed, & by God himself. 3) therefore we are living in a vast sphere of tyrannical evil: evil won 2000 years ago & controls all the centers. 4) the situation is not hopeless. 5) I am on the side of the Xtian opposition. 6) I am not alone; it is not _me_ against society but us. I am a secret authentic Xtian. 7) this is a historical matter. 8) it is Freedom -the Xtians - vs. slavery & slave labor. 9) "Tears" presents the truth. 10) I have been spreading the Cryptic Gospel of Christ without knowing it. 11) it is the plan of Christ to return. 12) the existing order will be overthrown. 13) it is _being_ overthrown. 14) I am involved. folder 49 - 023 folder 49 - 023 This boils down to : 1) I am aware of the reality of our world : the triumph of evil in all overt areas. & the secret Xtian opposition. 2) I am aware of my own identity, in particular in terms of my historical role : what I am for, what I am against. So I understand the true history & condition of the _world_; & _my_ true nature & affinities. suddenly everything makes sense - all that I have done : fought for, fought against. 1) the world is not as it seems to be. 2) I am not what I thought I was. There is a dreadful aspect to this world situation, obviously, but what offsets it is the realization of the secret Xtian underground : the primary realization is positive. I mean, it really is a stunning realization, to know of the true Xtians hidden in our midst. Society, history, my identity, religion, the struggle, what my work is really about - but the catalyst was realizing : The true Xtians have to keep hidden. This tells it all. Obviously the true situation is opposite to what we've always been told. The proof is that God fell silent, even for the Jews. God has been silent for 2000 years. Well, I have tried for almost six years to find a precedent for my experience, & failed. Except in the O.T. i.e. 2100 years ago. God "instilled" an early Xtian in me, in a "peripheral" person. This makes ["VR"] much more important than "V." That's incredible. It's as simple as that. In the first century A.D. God left human history instead of entering it. 180 degree different story, & told in ["VR."] Doesn't anyone think it's strange that God abruptly fell silent just at the time he supposedly entered human history? Wow - in ["VR"] I say, "The return of YHWH to Earth will be regard as the birth of a monster baby"! It's all totally turned around (as in "The Omen," etc). Look at the prejudice against YHWH as expressed by e.g. Will Durant, the Gnostics, by me. I only lost it when I read up on Martin Buber. folder 49 - 026 & meanwhile we get such garbage as C.S. Lewis saying "The Church can't err." ( It is even more correct than Scripture.) Consider : the situation in which the centers of power have fallen to the adversary & YHWH has to deal with "peripheral" people is exactly the situation at the time of Elijah. Right? _Now_ consider this : "Instilling" an early Xtian into me is exactly analogous to God sending back some (ale?) of Elijah's spirit to Elisha so Elisha could continue the former's work. I believe this is why it seems to Tom Disch that Elijah had taken me over in 3-74. The structure of the situation is identical in all respects! Oh - third point : the A I voice equals the "still small voice" that Elijah heard! _3_ parts of correspondence. Make it 4 : The theophany by Valis. Make it 5 : tongues of fire (the phosphene activity). Make it 6 : it happened at Passover.
